title: PerByte
tagline: A decentralized perpetual file storing and wallet-to-wallet file sharing platform and storage marketplace
description:
File and Data sharing has been one of the most crucial needs for users on the internet. This project aims to solve p2p file sharing from one wallet to another within clicks. It has the following features
- Users can upload files to filecoin just by dragging and dropping their files to the platform - 
- Users are human-verified using Worldcoin as bots need to be prevented from accessing spam upload requests
- DAOs and NFT Communities can use this system to share files with each other effortlessy through wallet addresses.
- Users can use the platform to create storage deals on the filecoin network and fetch thos deals using the FVM smart contract.
how_its_made: During the timeline of project, writing contracts and deploying to FVM was a little tricky. After attending the FVM workshop, things became clearer on the implemetation
